summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five AE-region stuck orders investigated. Four confirmed COMPLETED per latest ticket comments. One order remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after colour swap and partial cancellation failed. Consignment process still running and awaits warehouse progression. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  Five stuck AE orders investigated. Three resolved via stock update, shipping address fix, and PC-52918. Two remain at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — one awaiting warehouse shipment, one blocked on SMC UPDATE_ERROR pending PC-53305 approval. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns for the UAE PROD Daily SC+ report. Modified report script created under PC-53535 and reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Awaits deployment via HAC scripting console. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Trade-in clawback auto-triggered for two AE orders but Checkout.com declined both card authorisations. Orders are COMPLETED; clawback stuck at payment step. Awaiting confirmation of updated customer card details to re-trigger.

PC-5 — 

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable PC ticket for SMC re-registration remediation of order AE260819-63130115 from AEME-6500. Resets ExternalService from UPDATE_ERROR to NEW and retriggers consignment process. Blocked by parent AEME-6500, awaits approval.

PC-53535 — 
  SC+ daily report enhancement adding 18 SubscriptionData columns (U-AL) to gcc-PROD-Daily-SC-ReportScript. Script reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Awaits deployment via HAC scripting console and verification of new columns in daily report email. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  SA sales report enhanced with Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns (43 to 45). Updated SaSalesReport.groovy uses existing Order getters — no build required. Script complete and attached. Awaits upload and cronjob verification. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  SA screen repair order return blocked because GCIC service status exceeded cancellable window (ST030). Hybris correctly blocks return per business logic. Options: GCIC status rollback, config bypass, or manual refund via HAC with approvals. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  Seventeen TR-region stuck orders investigated via HAC DB verification. Five already resolved. Twelve remain across 5 root causes: FI connection errors, GetMobil NPE, refund failures, WMS dispatch blocks, and return shipping delays. New PC tickets needed. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Parent ticket for TR store C750_007_31536 master data creation. PC-53498 created with ImpEx generated from Excel template, field-verified against source data. Ticket approved, executed in production, and confirmed complete by reporter with minor backoffice updates. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
